newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Mother avenges son, throws acid in courtroom.
newsitem.headline: Mother avenges son, throws acid in courtroom.

text.p: A Russian woman seeking to avenge her son's death threw sulphuric acid over the three men accused of his murder as they sat in the dock of a Yekaterinburg court.
One was in hospital with severe burns while the two others escaped serious injury, Interfax news agency said on Wednesday.
The 56-year-old woman, whose husband committed suicide after their son's death, was arrested. Her name was not disclosed.
In April the mother of a slain teenage girl shot and wounded the murder suspect in a courtroom in the Russian Far East.
